content: The ruin of a great nation begins in the neglected homes of its people.
author: African Proverbs
explanation: Empires and republics do not collapse primarily because of foreign invasions; they rot from within when character, honesty, parental devotion, and mutual love dissolve around the domestic hearth. National renewal begins at the kitchen table.
practicalInsight: Pour your finest love, patience, and presence into your household tonight. Strengthen the bedrock.
reflectionPrompt: Are you burning out trying to reform the wider world while neglecting the peace and warmth of your own home?
